shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone panel
justification: Both are flat panels in low relief with profile-view subjects arranged in horizontal registers, and each contains a small disc-like round element and a band of repeated pattern, but these are generic conventions. A shows two elaborately dressed, bearded human figures facing one another with hands raised holding vessels and weapons, in a naturalistic, detailed idiom, whereas B shows schematic animals (a quadruped/carnivore above, a long-necked bird and other creatures below) with no human figures, no interaction between figures, and a far more abstracted, outline-only manner.
